correctness.rationale: The exact three-piece cover has intersections A_V and A_U and nullhomotopic inclusions, yielding the all-parameter integral sphere wedge. The invariant leaf subcomplex A carries the upper join module. Integral relative chains for (X,A) split into hub-center cone summands with full permutation lattices; the long exact sequence separates their degrees from the upper part because p,q >= 2. Graded join orientation gives the exact symmetry signs. Finite face and signed Lefschetz enumerations over F_2 and F_101 on seven uniform and three heterogeneous samples match the result but are not substituted for an integral proof.

originality.rationale: The 2021 and 2023 primary forest results cover qualitative wedge existence and provide nonequivariant reductions, which are credited. Full accessible text does not identify the weighted double-star homology multiplicities and canonical natural integer symmetry lattices. In particular neither gives the unsplit hub-color permutation extension or its hub-switch action. Relevant indexed path, cycle, higher-independence and multipath results do not logically imply the full double-star claim. This is originality against inspected materials, not exhaustive uniqueness.

value.rationale: A double star is the first forest with two adjacent branching hubs; the prior explicitly worked clique-expanded examples use path bases. The result gives exact graded integer ranks for arbitrary weighted fibers and a canonical complete fiber-preserving symmetry module rather than just a nonequivariant wedge. The nonsplit integral hub-color augmentation extension and sharp quotient rational acyclicity provide substantial structural information invisible to rational Betti numbers. No arbitrary forest generalization is asserted.
